gold: Multiple hereditary infundibulocystic basal cell carcinoma syndrome (MHIBCC)

selector.rationale: The presence of multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules and a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene support Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome, which is a more specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Gorlin syndrome
rejected.why: While some features are similar, the lack of palmar or plantar pits and jaw cysts, along with the specific genetic mutation, make Nevoid basal cell carcinoma syndrome a more precise diagnosis.
